cases.statement: One review-table entry only: Table 1 row 7 of a literature review, citing reference [44] (Biancheri 2013, not in this batch). The row lists c.235C>T (p.R79C) together with c.*29C>T for one recruited patient, age 10. No case description in this paper.

people.label: Table 1 #7
people.other_allele: same row lists a second GFAP variant, c.235C>T (p.R79C)
people.key_phenotypes: not interpretable per person: the review row gives column counts only, and its alignment with the header is uncertain

phenotype_specificity.statement: Only the review's inclusion criterion (juvenile and adult-onset AxD with a GFAP alteration) applies; no per-person description or exclusion of other causes.

quotes.quote: The inclusion criteria include patients affected with juvenile and adult-onset form of AxD who carried an alteration in GFAP.

variant_type_and_mechanism.statement: 3' UTR substitution (c.*29C>T); no amino-acid change predicted. The review's Table 2 marks it as 3UTR with protein NA. No mechanism statement for this variant.

computational_predictions.statement: Review Table 2 gives GERP 5.07; SIFT, MutationTaster, PROVEAN, FATHMM, CADD and PolyPhen-2 cells are '-'.

quotes.quote: Table notes: All the variants were analyzed based on the NM_002055, D damaging, T tolerated, DC disease causing, B benign

concerns: Appears only in a review table, without a case description; the primary report (ref [44], PMID 23254569) is not in this batch.
Another candidate variant in the same person: the same row lists c.235C>T (p.R79C), a coding change at codon 79.

Transcript: the review's Table 2 gives ENST00000588735.1 for this variant (not NM_002055.5), although the table notes say all variants were analysed on NM_002055; a 3' UTR c.* position depends on the transcript, so c.*29 may not correspond to NM_002055.5:c.*29.
Table 1 row 7 has a blank 'Number of carriers' cell and a 'B' under the DTR column; the row's alignment with the header is uncertain, so per-feature counts were not used.
Only an rsID (rs370608748) is given; no population frequency is stated.
notes_for_panel: hg19 position stated as chr17 42984686 (Table 2). Consider whether this is a phenotype-relevant variant at all, given the coding variant listed beside it; the panel may want the primary report.
